calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar May-24-2012 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of an Adult and of a Minor.
Dept. 514, Judge: K. Tsenin, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Sonia Wong, #11288

Petitioner Kong Jun Wu present in pro per for self and as guardian ad litem for the Minor Alvin Meng Wu, placed under oath and examined.
Declaration by Minor's Mother Janice Zeng, consenting to the name change of the minor and proof of service was filed 04-04-12.
Proof of Publication is in the file.

No objections to the proposed change of names were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name to Kong Jun Lee and Change of Name of the Minor to Alvin Meng Lee.
Decree Changing Names was submitted to and signed by the Court.
